steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Argh... Darn it! So many of them. There's no getting close to her!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You want us to come to you. Let us pass then! Why'd you send this bunch of monsters to stand in my way?
You take a step forward to face that contorted phantom.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Come on, tell me how I'm supposed to entertain you.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Hahaha... You're the best, even better than she ever was!
Innumerable dark tentacles extend from the hem of her dress and come rushing at you. Before your Sinners can block them, you reach out and grab some of the tentacles and they consume you.
